about.subtitle: Who I am, where I'm from, and the technologies I work with
about.bio_text: I am a 2nd-year student at the Faculty of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technologies. My goal is to become a skilled Full Stack Developer. I am actively mastering both Frontend and Backend technologies, working with PHP, C++, JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and the Laravel framework. In the future, I aim to build large-scale projects and launch my own startup.

projects.item.1.title: ZehnGo — Gamified Learning Platform
projects.item.1.description: A modern gamified online education and testing platform for students and teachers. Features interactive subject tests, live leaderboards, XP points, and dedicated Admin, Teacher, and Student dashboards.
projects.item.2.title: Rasm Converter Bot v2.0
projects.item.2.description: A Telegram bot (@word_pdf7_bot) and monitoring web platform that converts up to 30 images into A4 PDF and Microsoft Word (DOCX) documents in seconds, with smart 3–5x PDF compression.
projects.item.3.title: FreelanceHub
projects.item.3.description: A modern freelance marketplace connecting freelancers and clients across Uzbekistan. Enables finding skilled professionals, posting projects, and collaborating securely.
projects.item.4.title: SuperMarket
projects.item.4.description: A full-featured online supermarket e-commerce platform offering 5,000+ products, seamless shopping cart, promotions, and 24/7 delivery services.
projects.item.5.title: UyTop
projects.item.5.description: A modern real estate discovery platform where users can search for homes by location, property type, and price with detailed listings.
projects.item.6.title: FitLife
projects.item.6.description: A modern fitness platform designed to support a healthy lifestyle with professional trainers, workout programs, and personalized services.
projects.item.7.title: SamSU Dining Hall
projects.item.7.description: A modern website providing complete information about the Samarkand State University dining hall, including menu, pricing, opening hours, and contact details.
projects.item.8.title: Register & Login System
projects.item.8.description: A complete authentication system for user registration and sign-in, featuring validation, security checks, and a clean modern UI.
